pulse.currentFocus: S346 recovery verified locally: 390 build checks, 215 mobile checks, and 42 reviewed theme captures. Create the recovery checkpoint, then continue the S347 full arc.
pulse.nextMilestone: Checkpoint the verified recovery and complete the S347 audit, implementation, staging verification, and closeout.
blockers: Community accessibility CI reports an empty member link; correction and fresh hosted evidence remain required before release.
Identity migration and real provider-journey evidence remain incomplete; the existing identity release hold remains in place.
Human signup acceptance remains unobserved. Editorial cadence remains an existing owner decision.

now: [S345][DEPLOY/P0] Full production deploy, both lanes, founder-authorised. DONE S345. Staging refreshed first per CANON-007 by the operator overlay (403 overlays, 26 safe removals, identity untouched, exact-byte verified), then promoted through the SCOPED path -- `check-promotion-scope` reported `promotable=true - scoped-disjoint` against BOTH active hold reasons (`real-provider-e2e-pending`, `supabase-control-plane-partial`), and the identity hold was never cleared. Content lane: `pages-deploy` run `34153075898` green; production serves HEAD `998243a3f76643c70ece998f7f75c748aa0d1bf2` exactly, not a baseline stamp. Worker lane second (it deadlocks on `deploy-currency-live` otherwise): run `34153477094` passed the canonical release ceremony, deployed, and cleared the post-deploy liveness gate with no rollback. Verified live: strict CSP with the sha allowlist, HSTS preload, TT report-only, and `/ /news/ /status/ /membership/ /evidence/` all 200. `deploy-currency` now reads `production current - 0 commit(s) behind`. Precondition the content lane needs and CI cannot produce: `build-worker-route-provenance --probe` from a residential vantage, matched 7/7.

[S345][BUILD/P1] `check-evidence-graph-coverage.mjs` executed its own ratchet when imported. DONE S345. `else run()` at module scope meant any consumer that imported `checkedGenerators`/`coverage` would run the gate and hit its `process.exit`. Found by needing the import for the sweep above, not by a gate -- nothing imported it before. Fixed with the repo's established `isDirect` guard; both direct invocation and `--self-test` (7/7) unchanged, and the import is now silent.

[S345][BUILD/P3] 38 byte-checked generators are still outside the evidence graph. The S345 sweep makes this SAFE (drift is now caught and named at repair time) but not CLOSED: the graph still cannot order these nodes topologically, so `--sweep-repair` rebuilds them independently and a node whose source is another unmodeled node's output could need two passes. Modeling them requires real `sources` per node -- the ratchet exists precisely to stop that being guessed. Correct next step is to model them a few at a time, at the moment someone knows the inputs, lowering the baseline each time (now 38/67). Not urgent: the sweep converts what was a silent CI red into a local named failure.

[S344][UX/P0] The homepage returning-visitor strip had never rendered, and two theme defects were hiding behind that. DONE S344. Found by doing the CANON-053 pixel check on the surface fixed above — it would not render. `returning-visitor-digest.js` loads first (`ambient-loader.js`, both `idle`) and stamps `vs_last_visit_ts` to `now` before `returning-signal-strip.js` reads the same key, so no entry was ever newer than "last visit". Proved with a control blocking only the digest: strip renders, baseline preserved. Same class as the S343 `vs_visit_count` fix, same two files, neighbouring key. Fixed with a one-writer handoff key `vs_prev_visit_ts` (absent = bail, self-heals next visit). Underneath it: `--vs-text` is defined nowhere so every theme used a near-white fallback (invisible on light), and brand gold measured 1.31:1 on cream. Now `--text` plus a light-only `#8a6a00` (4.72:1). 7/7 themes clear WCAG AA on all four elements, measured from painted pixels after two computed-style readings were wrong. See D-S344.6.

[S344][CI/P0] A skipped step read as a successful step, four guards deep. DONE S344. `news-publish.yml` chained on `if: steps.<X>.outputs.status == '0'`; a SKIPPED step writes no output and GitHub coerces `''` and `'0'` to the same number, so the guard passed for a step that never ran. In run `34063581495` the art renderer, Desk rebuild, editorial gates and public-feed cascade all executed on a slot that drafted nothing. Fixed with a non-numeric `ok=yes/no` sentinel across all 7 guards, plus `check-workflow-step-guards.mjs` (10/10 self-test, in `build:check`, 29 workflows clean) run against the pre-fix file as a negative control -- it caught all 7. See D-S344.3.

[S344][CI/P0] `generate-news-art.mjs` crashed with a raw ENOENT stack on the normal dropped slot. DONE S344. Unguarded `readdirSync('.cache/news-drafts')`. Shipped in the SAME change as the guard fix and never alone: this crash was one of only two things preventing an unattended commit of a non-edition. Exit code deliberately unchanged (still non-zero) so promotion stays gated.

[S344][UX/P0] The homepage published CI jargon to returning visitors, and the filter meant to stop it was dead code. DONE S344. `MOVE_VERB[commit.move] || MOVE_VERB[commit.type]` meant `chore: null` was never reached, because chore maps to move `Tended` -> truthy `Refined`. 13 of 24 live sentences were chore commits. Fixed the precedence, added structural `visitorFacing` classification (producer + reader shipped together; absent field = not publishable), stripped `(attempt N)`, and pinned the exact leaked sentence. Feed 24 -> 8, every survivor visitor-visible. Closes [VOICE/P1] from S343. See D-S344.4.

[S345][ENG/P0] FOUNDER: run the member-newsletter deploy (one command). Re-probed S345 and both faults are STILL LIVE: `--status` against a project-scoped 200 reports `project fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp (reachable, 29 functions deployed)` / `function: NOT DEPLOYED` / `NEWSLETTER_SECRET (GitHub Actions): ABSENT`, and `gh secret list` confirms the secret is absent while `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` is present. So the credential path is OPEN and this is not a phantom blocker (CANON-019) -- `--self-test` passes 5/5. The agent path is blocked by the Claude Code sandbox permission classifier, which denied `--deploy` in S344 and again in S345; running the same script through a different shell would be working around the denial rather than clearing it, so it was not attempted. Founder: `! node scripts/deploy-member-newsletter.mjs --deploy` then `--secret` then `--verify` (verify stops at the 404->401 boundary and mails nobody). The function has no dry-run, so the first real send should stay a founder-observed `workflow_dispatch`. This is also the sole remaining doctor red (`sched-staleness`, advisory).  <!-- was: [S344][ENG/P0] FOUNDER: authorise the member-newsletter deploy -->
next: [NEXT][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet. Add stable fact rows and validated factRefs joining factual evidence to stances and visual anchors; publish a per-story public-safe argument map and one-click critique packet with no runtime model spend.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Field-vitals freshness closure. Surface observed-through/stale-days, restore a fresh post-S262 RUM window, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so fresh generatedAt can never imply fresh field evidence.
